$comment: The normative limits and error identifiers, machine-readable. NOT a second authority: spec/SPEC.md and spec/errors.md remain the text that defines them, and tools/gen-limits.mjs refuses to render this file unless every value and every code here is stated there. Rendered into each host's constants (see spec/limits.md).

MAX_DEPTH.meaning: parser nesting and evaluation nesting, each; exceeding either is E_DEPTH

MAX_INT_DIGITS.meaning: integer digits of a number; beyond it E_RANGE

MAX_FRAC_DIGITS.meaning: fractional digits of a number; beyond it E_RANGE

MAX_TEXT_LEN.meaning: code points of a TEXT value, bytes of a BIN value, that an operation may build; beyond it E_RANGE

MAX_COLLECTION.meaning: children of a collection an operation may build (`,`, LIST, RECORD, SPLIT, BTL, LINK); beyond it E_RANGE

MAX_REGEX_PATTERN.meaning: code points of a regex pattern; beyond it E_REGEX_SYNTAX

MAX_REGEX_GROUPS.meaning: groups (capturing and non-capturing) in a regex pattern; beyond it E_REGEX_SYNTAX

MAX_ROUND_SCALE.meaning: the scale argument of ROUND(x, n); beyond it E_RANGE

MAX_POWER_EXPONENT.meaning: the exponent argument of POWER(x, n); beyond it E_RANGE

MAX_REGEX_QUANTIFIER.meaning: a regex quantifier bound, as in a{n} or a{n,m} (PCRE2's own hard limit); beyond it E_REGEX_SYNTAX

REGEX_AMBIGUITY_BUDGET.meaning: the regex ambiguity budget, the summed log2 of the finite choices outside every loop; above it E_REGEX_SYNTAX

REGEX_ANALYSIS_POSITIONS.meaning: positions of the regex ambiguity analysis (2^17); more is E_REGEX_SYNTAX

REGEX_ANALYSIS_EDGES.meaning: follow edges of the regex ambiguity analysis (2^18); more is E_REGEX_SYNTAX

REGEX_ANALYSIS_RANGES.meaning: the sum over follow edges of the ranges at the target (2^21); above it E_REGEX_SYNTAX

REGEX_ANALYSIS_PAIR_WORK.meaning: units of pair-graph work of the regex ambiguity analysis (2^20); more is E_REGEX_SYNTAX

MAX_SQL_NODES.meaning: nodes of the expression the SQL translator renders, an inlined or unrolled subtree counted once per occurrence; beyond it E_SQL_SIZE (sql/errors.md)

DIV_SCALE.meaning: fractional digits long division runs to before rounding half away from zero
